data.narrative:
HIMERA is a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Misha Rudominsky and Oleksiy Oliynyk that has raised $2.5M+. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, primarily at seed and Series A stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $2M total-raised proxy as a base and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage transitions, implying a $6M valuation. Peer-median analysis references five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.0B and a range from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), directly implying $1.0B. The median peer valuation reflects both seed-stage entrants valued at $1.0B (UFORCE) and Series A companies spanning $125M to $4.0B.

Triangulation across both methods yields a range of $5M to $1.1B, with a median of $503M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around stage positioning and peer selection within a volatile frontier-defense sector. The stage-progression method produces the low end; the peer-median dominates the upper bound. Key uncertainties include the degree to which seed-stage defense companies command billion-dollar valuations and whether HIMERA's technology and team warrant positioning at the top or bottom of peer comparables.
